title: Python: B.2.4 Explicit Backpressure
description:
Return QueueFull error for immediate sends, NACK for mesh-forwarded packets when queue full.

--------

MUST/SHALL Checklist (extracted from spec/appendix-bufferbloat.md B.2.4):

1. [_] When TX queue is full and incoming packet has same/lower priority, MUST return ENOBUFS/QueueFull error to local sender
2. [_] When forwarding buffer per-source limit is reached, MUST send NACK upstream to mesh source
3. [_] Senders MUST handle queue-full errors by either: (a) backing off and retrying later, or (b) dropping the packet and notifying the application

Test Validation (from spec Testing section):
- Queue-full handling: Sender gets ENOBUFS when queue full
